in_latin.name: Amand
in_latin.meaning: Amandus - Latin for lovable, or one who is worthy of love
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Amand is derived from the Latin word 'amandus,' meaning lovable or worthy of love. It was popularized in the Christian tradition by several early saints, reflecting the spiritual significance of love and devotion.
